description: No clean concept. Fires most when the opponent has built a cluster in the lower-left/center, especially stones on (2,2), (1,3), (1,2), (2,1), (3,1), often with the last opponent stone just placed at (2,1)/(2,2)/(3,1), column 4 empty, and none of my stones on (0,4), (1,3) or (2,2). Such positions are often forced or lost for me, but threats alone do not predict firing.
effect: Small and inconsistent: when strongly active it tends to lower column 1 by about 0.12-0.13 probability (two positions), shifting mass to other columns; elsewhere changes are under 0.1.
notes: Tried: any opponent threat in cols 0-4 with (0,4) not mine (F1 0.11); opponent stones on anti-diagonal (0,4)-(4,0) (F1 0.17); last-stone cell + O neighbours (F1 0.15); number of immediately losing columns (F1 0.14); hand-weighted cell score from single-cell histograms (F1 0.16 at thr 8, 0.22 at thr 6, best). Minimal pairs show strong position-specific effects (e.g. my stone at (0,4) kills a col-2 vertical-three response; 0,1,0,2 fires but 0,1,6,2 does not). Likely mixture or random direction. Synthesis reaches 18.3 vs dev max 14.55.
